public_rationale: Ramp's economist reported the 80% concentration figure. That does not establish that the entire concentrated share relies on unstable capital or spending. Anthropic's later filing acknowledges renewal risk, but supplies no matching percentage. The missing link is evidence about the financial durability of the customers responsible for the claimed revenue.
limitations: Customer concentration is not itself a measure of customer financial fragility.
The source estimate's period and coverage are undisclosed.
The enterprise-revenue reading is supplied by the surrounding context.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The 80% of OpenAI and Anthropic's revenue from top customers depends on spending and capital ranging from unreliable to unstable.

statement.excerpt: 80% of their revenue concentration depends on spending and capital that varies from unreliable to actively-unstable.

our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion identifies 'their' as OpenAI and Anthropic.
Read the denominator as enterprise revenue, because the post introduces the 80% figure as an enterprise-revenue concentration estimate. Applying it to total revenue would be a separate extrapolation.
The plain reading requires evidence of fragile customer financing or unusually insecure spending, beyond the ordinary possibility that any customer can reduce purchases.
Use July 2026 as the latest monthly enterprise-spending reporting period demonstrably public before the post. The precise observation window behind the separate 80% statement is not disclosed.
The accounting basis is estimate because the claim relies on an outside transaction-data estimate, not either lab's reported accounts.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable customer-level evidence shows approximately 80% of each lab's enterprise revenue came from customers whose payments depended on demonstrably fragile financing or spending.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence shows the exposed share was materially below 80%, or shows durable financing and spending commitments for enough of the claimed exposed revenue to invalidate the asserted share.
